cases.title: Enterprise table with bulk operations
cases.prompt: Design a dense employee-access management screen for administrators. They review 500-5000 users, filter by organization and status, compare roles, select many rows, change access in bulk, inspect exceptions, and recover from partial failures.

constraints: authoritative table and button components exist

expected_behaviors: use realistic long names and many roles
critical_errors: bulk action can silently affect hidden rows
partial failure is treated as full success
important role or audit data is lost on narrower widths

cases.title: Complex configuration form
cases.prompt: Design a policy configuration flow with dependent fields, inherited values, validation against server rules, autosave draft, explicit publish, permission differences, and an expert need to compare old and new values.

constraints: not all validation can happen locally
some fields are inherited and read-only

expected_behaviors: preserve user input after server errors

cases.title: Research repository empty and first-use state
cases.prompt: Design the first-use experience for a research repository. A new team has no studies yet, may have imported interview notes, and needs to understand the value of structured research without being forced through a long onboarding tour.

constraints: import and create are both valid starts
terminology must match the research domain

expected_behaviors: explain value through the next useful action
avoid decorative empty-state illustration as the whole solution
support import and create without competing primaries
critical_errors: empty state has no route to value
sample data can be mistaken for real data

cases.title: Destructive archive with dependencies
cases.prompt: Design the archive action for a project that contains active tasks, integrations, and reports. Archiving is reversible for 30 days, but integrations stop immediately and some scheduled jobs are cancelled.

constraints: dependency impact is available from API

critical_errors: restore availability is promised without permission evidence

cases.title: Mobile field-service task flow
cases.prompt: Design a mobile task flow for field technicians working outdoors with gloves, intermittent connectivity, one-handed use, and repeated photo/status updates.
expected_behaviors: make queued versus synced status clear
avoid relying on small icons or color alone
critical_errors: remote reassignment overwrites local work silently
critical targets are too small or unreachable

cases.title: Role-adaptive operations dashboard
cases.prompt: Design a dashboard used by operators, supervisors, and executives. The same system must support real-time issue handling, team workload review, and weekly strategic trends without becoming three unrelated products.

context.users: three roles with different frequencies and decisions

expected_behaviors: adapt defaults and emphasis by role
support drill-down from summary to action
critical_errors: one universal dashboard ignores role decisions
operators cannot act from detected issues

cases.title: Design-system constrained feature
cases.prompt: Design a split-button-like action using an existing Button, Menu, and Popover system. The feature team requests a new bespoke component, but the governed system does not contain one.
expected_behaviors: define primary and menu action relationship
critical_errors: generated local style is used as authority

cases.title: Localization and extreme-content stress test
cases.prompt: Review a polished account screen that was designed only with short English labels and ideal data. Test it for German and Russian localization, long names, missing avatars, very large balances, RTL readiness, and 200% zoom.
expected_behaviors: check reading order and number formatting
critical_errors: zoom causes horizontal loss of core task

cases.title: Accessible modal workflow
cases.prompt: Review an edit-profile modal with validation, asynchronous save, outside-click close, Escape, nested date picker, and a success message. The visual result is polished.

cases.title: Adversarial critique of a polished concept
cases.prompt: Critique a visually impressive SaaS concept with large gradients, many floating cards, three prominent CTAs, hidden navigation, and sparse real content. Assume stakeholders already like its appearance.
expected_behaviors: separate aesthetic appeal from task quality
restore visible frequent navigation where justified
critical_errors: all gradients/shadows are banned without context
stakeholder preference is treated as usability evidence

cases.title: Prototype fidelity decision
cases.prompt: Choose and justify prototype fidelity for testing a new enterprise approval model whose main uncertainty is whether users understand delegation, escalation, and responsibility transfer. Visual style is already governed.
expected_behaviors: represent responsibility and state changes realistically
use governed components only where they affect comprehension
separate concept learning from visual acceptance
critical_errors: prototype fidelity is chosen by habit
test measures preference instead of understanding
critical state transitions are static or omitted
visual polish is treated as validation

cases.title: Blind human-agent comparison template
cases.prompt: Evaluate two independent solutions to the same professional-product task without knowing which was created by a human or agent. Produce dimension profiles, disagreement notes, and a combined-solution hypothesis.
expected_behaviors: do not collapse to one total score
record evidence for every material difference
separate presentation polish from design quality
critical_errors: one solution gets more context or time

cases.title: Pattern composition for a multi-document editor
cases.prompt: Design the interaction model for a professional document editor where users keep several documents open, compare versions, use keyboard shortcuts, preview changes, undo several steps, and return to interrupted work.

context.users: frequent expert editors with occasional new users

expected_behaviors: compose creation workspace, many workspaces, preview, history, and undo deliberately
preserve stable locations and document state
separate novice guidance from expert accelerators
define stale preview and conflict behavior
critical_errors: copies a canvas layout without contextual forces
loses dirty documents on workspace switch
changes standard shortcut meaning by mode

cases.title: Question Protocol and form reduction
cases.prompt: Redesign a registration flow that currently asks for full name, company, job title, phone, country, password, password confirmation, marketing consent, and referral source before users can try the product.

constraints: email is required for account access
some profile data may be useful later

expected_behaviors: give product value before unnecessary profile collection
avoid password confirmation when a safer correction method exists
explain why any retained sensitive field is needed
critical_errors: retains fields because competitors ask them
uses placeholder as the only label
disables submit with no recovery guidance

cases.title: Accessible validation and focus recovery
cases.prompt: Review a long server-validated benefits application. After submit, the page reloads at the top, invalid fields are only outlined in red below the fold, entered values sometimes disappear, and keyboard focus remains on the browser chrome.

context.users: mixed digital literacy including keyboard and screen-reader users

required_evidence: error summary and local error model
expected_behaviors: preserve all valid and invalid input
announce and focus a useful summary
link errors to controls and keep local context
critical_errors: focus is not restored to task context
generic invalid messages with no fix

cases.title: Long multi-actor regulated process
cases.prompt: Design an application process that takes days, requires documents, has eligibility checks, and passes between an applicant, reviewer, and approver. Tasks may be returned for correction and users need to resume later.
expected_behaviors: split work into meaningful tasks rather than arbitrary pages
critical_errors: one giant wizard hides multi-actor ownership

cases.title: Linked data investigation workspace
cases.prompt: Design an incident investigation workspace with a timeline, map, event table, and metric trends. Selecting records in one view must reveal the same subset in the others, while analysts compare exact values and preserve filters.

constraints: selections may include thousands of rows

expected_behaviors: keep units, freshness, and exact values visible
show records missing from a projection
provide clear reset and selection scope
critical_errors: dual axes or color distort meaning
selection cannot be cleared or inspected

cases.title: Portable execution without vendor plugin
cases.prompt: Turn an approved design decision into an interactive responsive prototype. The runtime has a browser, screenshot capture, image generation, and code execution, but no Product Design plugin or design-tool export.

constraints: prototype must cover error and empty states

critical_errors: accepts generated prototype without state or accessibility review
changes the product decision during execution without record

cases.title: Optional OpenAI Product Design bridge
cases.prompt: Codex visibly exposes the OpenAI Product Design plugin with Get Context, Ideate, Audit, Design QA, and Image To Code. Plan how CPT should use it to accelerate a redesign while remaining portable to agents where the plugin is absent.

constraints: only visible skills may be invoked
CPT owns design decision and gates

expected_behaviors: freeze design brief and acceptance before build
use Design QA as supporting evidence
critical_errors: lets plugin own problem framing or final verdict

cases.title: Image-to-code fidelity and uncertainty
cases.prompt: A tool has converted a screenshot into responsive frontend code and reports success. Review whether it can be accepted into a governed product repository.

constraints: screenshot shows only one state and width
interaction behavior is not visible in the image

expected_behaviors: separate visual similarity from product correctness
critical_errors: accepts provider self-report as final QA
copies raw values instead of design tokens
claims responsive fidelity from one screenshot
